nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract, set to msg.sender in the constructor; the root of the onlyOwner access control check.
Pending owner address written by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, set to 'BRC' in the BRCToken constructor.
Public token name string, set to 'BRC Token' in the BRCToken constructor.
Public token decimals value, set to 18 in the BRCToken constructor.
Total token supply, minted to the deployer address in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping(address => uint) holding token balances; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding spender allowances; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, onlyOwner authorization, balance ownership and allowance spender accounting.
SafeMath helper performing checked addition (c = a + b; require(c >= a)).
SafeMath helper performing checked subtraction (require(b <= a); c = a - b).
SafeMath helper performing checked multiplication with division-based overflow guard.
SafeMath helper performing checked division (require(b > 0)).
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner into newOwner.
Completes ownership handover; requires msg.sender == newOwner then moves owner and clears newOwner.
Token constructor initializing metadata and minting the entire supply to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the token balance of the supplied tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
ERC20 transfer debiting msg.sender and crediting the to address using safeSub/safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no double-spend check.
Spends allowance from 'from' to 'to', decreasing balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender].
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance for msg.sender and then invokes an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval, an external callback executed inside the state-changing flow.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting Ether.
onlyOwner rescue function that calls transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary attacker-supplied token address.
Arithmetic addition inside safeAdd protected only by a require-based overflow guard (a + b).
Arithmetic subtraction inside safeSub protected by require(b <= a) (a - b).
Arithmetic multiplication inside safeMul guarded by a division consistency check (a * b).
Arithmetic division inside safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0) (a / b).
Balance debit/credit arithmetic in transfer: balances[msg.sender] - tokens and balances[to] + tokens via SafeMath calls.
Balance and allowance arithmetic in transferFrom: two safeSub calls and one safeAdd call on balances/allowed mappings.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) with an attacker-controlled spender contract; classic callback/reentrancy surface.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an owner-supplied but otherwise unvalidated token address.
Recipient address argument of transfer.
Amount of tokens argument of transfer.
Spender address argument of approve.
Allowance amount argument of approve.
Source address argument of transferFrom whose balance is debited.
Destination address argument of transferFrom whose balance is credited.
Amount argument of transferFrom applied to both balance and allowance.
Spender contract address argument of approveAndCall that becomes the external call target.
Allowance amount argument of approveAndCall.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to the spender in receiveApproval.
Arbitrary token contract address supplied by the owner for the rescue call.
Token amount argument of transferAnyERC20Token forwarded to the external transfer.
Local return variable c holding the computed sum in safeAdd.
Candidate new owner address argument of transferOwnership.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned into the owner state variable during Owned construction, making the deployer the privileged account.
The Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
The onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership can stage a new owner.
The _newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership and is stored.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before ownership is finalized.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with the accepted newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after handover.
msg.sender identifies the account whose balance is debited in transfer.
The to parameter determines the credited account in transfer.
The tokens parameter determines the transferred amount in transfer.
transfer executes balance debit/credit arithmetic, the arithmetic-sensitive operation.
transfer delegates its subtraction to safeSub, tying the function to arithmetic handling.
transfer delegates its addition to safeAdd, tying the function to arithmetic handling.
The computed arithmetic results are written back into the balances mapping.
approve records the allowance for msg.sender.
The spender parameter keys the allowance entry in approve.
The tokens parameter is the approved allowance value in approve.
approve overwrites the allowed nested mapping.
The from parameter selects the balance and allowance being debited in transferFrom.
The to parameter selects the credited balance in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is applied to both balance and allowance reductions in transferFrom.
msg.sender identifies the spender whose allowance allowed[from][msg.sender] is consumed in transferFrom.
transferFrom performs arithmetic on balances and allowances, the arithmetic-sensitive operation.
Arithmetic results in transferFrom are written back into the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping for the spender.
approveAndCall grants the allowance to msg.sender as the token owner.
The spender parameter is both the allowance key and the external call target in approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter is the approved amount forwarded to receiveApproval.
The data parameter is attacker-influenced calldata forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before invoking the external contract.
approveAndCall hands control to an arbitrary spender contract through receiveApproval while allowance state has just been modified.
The external receiveApproval call returns control to approveAndCall, enabling reentrant re-entry into token functions.
The tokenAddress parameter determines the external contract targeted by transferAnyERC20Token.
The tokens parameter is forwarded to the external token transfer call.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts transferAnyERC20Token to the owner resolved from msg.sender.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract via ERC20Interface.transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token uses the owner state variable as the recipient of the rescued tokens.
safeAdd contains the guarded addition operation.
safeSub contains the guarded subtraction operation.
safeMul contains the guarded multiplication operation.
safeDiv contains the guarded division operation.
The local result variable c receives the computed sum inside safeAdd.
balanceOf reads from the balances mapping.
allowance reads from the allowed nested mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
The BRCToken constructor assigns the minted supply to _totalSupply.
The BRCToken constructor credits the entire supply to a fixed address in the balances mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: The transfer 'to' parameter only exists to key the credited balance inside transfer, so it should be folded into that function node.
The transfer 'tokens' parameter only feeds the arithmetic inside transfer and should be absorbed by it.
The approve 'spender' parameter is only used to index the allowed mapping inside approve.
The approve 'tokens' parameter is only the stored allowance value inside approve.
The transferFrom 'from' parameter is only used to select the debited balance/allowance inside transferFrom.
The transferFrom 'to' parameter only selects the credited balance inside transferFrom.
The transferFrom 'tokens' parameter only feeds the balance/allowance arithmetic inside transferFrom.
The approveAndCall 'spender' parameter is both the allowance key and the external call target of approveAndCall.
The approveAndCall 'tokens' parameter is only the approved amount handled by approveAndCall.
The approveAndCall 'data' parameter is only meaningful as the payload of the external receiveApproval call, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
The transferAnyERC20Token 'tokenAddress' parameter exists solely to determine the external call target, so it merges into the external-call unsafe operation.
The transferAnyERC20Token 'tokens' parameter is only forwarded to the external transfer call, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
The local c in safeAdd is just the computed sum returned by that helper function.
The '_newOwner' parameter only carries the staged owner value written by transferOwnership.
